name: git_compose_collect
description: Start here to turn uncommitted changes into one or more clean commits. Returns an index map of the changed hunks (grouped by file, no patch bodies), authoring instructions, and a `based_on` token. If you made these changes in this session, author the commit plan from this index map and call git_compose_apply. If you did not, call git_compose_read for the hunks you need before authoring. Read-only: nothing is modified.

exclude.description: Glob patterns; matching files are skipped. Same syntax limits as include

include.description: Glob patterns; only matching files are collected. No brace {a,b} or bracket [abc] groups, and ** must be its own path segment (src/**/x.go)
